title: A cambio de: lo que se pide o se ofrece por algo

sections.content: A cambio de (in exchange for) names what one party gives, requires, or offers in a transaction or agreement -- essential for describing conditional deals like loans with strings attached. It's followed by a noun phrase or que + subjunctive. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: El FMI ofrecía nuevos préstamos a cambio de que los gobiernos aceptaran una serie de condiciones económicas.
items.english: The IMF offered new loans in exchange for governments accepting a series of economic conditions.

items.spanish: Estas condiciones incluían, a cambio del financiamiento, recortes significativos en el gasto público.
items.english: These conditions included, in exchange for the financing, significant cuts to public spending.

items.spanish: Los defensores argumentaban que valía la pena aceptar sacrificios a cambio de recuperar la estabilidad macroeconómica.
items.english: Supporters argued it was worth accepting sacrifices in exchange for restoring macroeconomic stability.

items.spanish: Muchos críticos consideraban que el precio pagado, a cambio de estos préstamos, era demasiado alto en términos de soberanía.
items.english: Many critics considered that the price paid, in exchange for these loans, was too high in terms of sovereignty.

sections.content: A cambio de que + subjunctive works when a full clause follows (a cambio de que aceptaran); a cambio de + noun works when only a noun phrase follows (a cambio del financiamiento) -- don't mix the two structures.
